## Goal
Every exposure scan and every "check by hand" link puts a few profile values into a URL on the broker's site. `Broker.search_url_pattern` may use only `first last middle city state state_name zip phone` (`models.py:54-55`); `submitters/web_form.search_url` fills them and returns None when a value is missing, and a phone number only with `allow_phone_disclosure` (`submitters/web_form.py:98-123`). The extra pages (`old_address_url`, `previous_name_url`, `engine/exposure.py:520-557`) reuse it. Tests only: prove over the real bundled registry and over synthetic patterns that a URL never carries more than that, and never a street, birth date, age, relative, personal email or the removal mailbox. Defects in `submitters/` or `models.py` are findings with file:line (strict xfail), not edits.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For every broker in `brokers/registry.yaml` (load it through `registry`, skip nothing silently: assert the count is above 100), the set of placeholders in `search_url_pattern` is a subset of the allowed set; list any pattern that uses `zip` or `phone` in VENDOR_STATUS.md as information.
2. For a fake profile whose street, birth date, age, relatives, personal email and mailbox are sentinel strings, no URL from `search_url`, `old_address_url`, `previous_name_url` or `exposure._hand_check_url` over all registry brokers contains a sentinel (URL-decoded and raw).
3. With default permissions, no URL contains the profile's phone digits (any separators); with `allow_phone_disclosure=True` only patterns that contain `{phone}` contain them.
4. For a phone-only or email-only person (`value_only`), name searches return None, and value URLs contain only that value (`web_form.value_search_urls`, `web_form.py:165-186`); the other kind of value never appears.
5. `old_address_url` differs from the main URL only in the city/state/zip parts; a previous name URL differs only in the name parts (compare after replacing those values with a marker).
6. Every produced URL is https and on the broker's own domains (`on_broker_url`).
7. No network (autouse socket block); `tmp_path` only.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
